The venue hosted a kickboxing card from the MMA promoter Duel: Arena, and one of the matches was a fight between Paul Miller, a far-right white supremacist influencer who spent time in federal prison on gun charges, and Ben Azoulay, a Jewish Israeli fighter. During the event, Miller supporters held up a Nazi flag, threw Nazi salutes, got into brawls, and screamed in the face of a female security guard after she confiscated the flag.
